I love the experience of wandering through a museum and stopping to look at whatever catches my eye. I wanted to recreate that feeling digitally, rather than using a traditional, boring website. Open Metropolitan lets you: - Explore over 340k artworks on an infinite canvas.
- Select any artwork and discover visually similar pieces.
- Search the collection using natural language.
- Sort art across centuries using a Time Machine feature. The project is completely free, and I personally pay all the hosting

show_hn.title: Show HN: Distributed Algorithms of Ancient Greece
show_hn.story_text: Hello! A few months back I learnt that Leslie Lamport's popular distributed computing paper on the Paxos algorithm is completely written as an allegory, describing a process followed in (fictional) ancient Greece. I was fascinated by it and wanted to see how other popular distributed computing papers would be if described in a similar allegory. The result, after 3 iterations, is this site. It helped me understand distributed computing concepts better and hope it will for you too!
